messages:
maya: FYI — FinEdge asked to ship quantization + smart batching + prefix caching for their pilot in ~12w. They said it's blocking their demo. Can we do a quick RICE and pick an MVP?
jonah: can we scope what "MVP" means here? quant only? batching only? all three staged?
sara: My read: customer cares about latency (demo feels real-time) and cost. Quantization reduces cost, batching reduces token cost under load, caching reduces latency on repeated prompts. Different metrics.
kevin: infra note — batching needs runtime changes (continuous batching) and some autoscale config. Caching needs KV store + cache invalidation policy; quantization needs model conversion + perf testing. Effort order probably: quant -> batching -> caching.
maya: Agreed on sequence. Proposed MVP = quant + small autoscale knob so they see cost drop and no infra work for caching. Then Q2 add batching and Q3 caching.
lia: Sales pressure: FinEdge will pay if demo wins; they'd prefer all 3 but will accept quant+batching if timeline is aggressive.
sara: Let's do a quick RICE sketch (numbers are relative, 1-10). Impact = reduced infra cost + better demo latency; Reach = pilot user base (small). Confidence low because unknowns.
jonah: drop in tokens/cost matters to them; but latency is what they perceive. Quant helps cost, caching helps perceived latency the most for repeated queries.
maya: throwing draft RICE numbers:
```
Feature        Reach  Impact  Confidence  Effort(days)  RICE score
Quantization     5      6        7          10            210
Batching         4      5        6          12            120
Prefix caching    3      8        5          15            80
```
(Score = (Reach*Impact*Confidence)/Effort * 10 — very rough)
kevin: those effort estimates look optimistic for batching; continuous batching perf testing on long-tail prompts might be +20d.
sara: also add qualitative: quant risks model quality regressions. Need evals tied to FinEdge prompt set as a gating criterion.
maya: launch criteria proposal: quant quality delta < 2% on FinEdge eval, latency not worse than current for tail, infra cost drop >= 20% for their workload. If quant fails, fallback to float32 but enable autoscale to show cost delta.
lia: can we get a verbal commitment from FinEdge to provide prompt set + eval labels? that'll raise Confidence.
jonah: I'll sketch a minimal plan for quant pipeline and a test harness we can run on FinEdge prompts. Target: PoC in 3w, ship MVP in 8-10w if no big regressions.
maya: OK — action items: @jonah draft PoC plan (due EOD Wed), @lia ask FinEdge for prompt set + SLA expectations (due Mon), @sara design eval metrics and gating criteria, @kevin enumerate infra changes + estimated days.
kevin: noted. one caveat — if batching ends up being +20d, we might flip sequence: quant -> caching (fast infra work?) -> batching. need more detail.
sara: I'll add open questions to the doc: quality thresholds, allowed cost delta, canaries for live dataset.
maya: thanks. If everyone is aligned I'll call this the proposed roadmap for FinEdge pilot and push to the sprint board. obj: keep MVP small, measurable, and reversible. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: reminder — weekly roadmap sync scheduled Thu 09:00.
